# --- interface ---
    interface ethernet-1/1 {
        description vers-r4
        admin-state enable
        mtu 1514
        subinterface 0 {
            admin-state enable
            ip-mtu 1500
            ipv4 {
                admin-state enable
                address 10.2.45.2/30 {
                }
            }
            ipv6 {
                admin-state enable
                address 2001:db8:2:45::3/127 {
                }
            }
        }
    }
    interface ethernet-1/2 {
        description LAN-pc2
        admin-state enable
        subinterface 0 {
            admin-state enable
            ipv4 {
                admin-state enable
                address 192.168.2.1/24 {
                }
            }
            ipv6 {
                admin-state enable
                address 2001:db8:a2::1/64 {
                }
            }
        }
    }
    interface lo0 {
        admin-state enable
        subinterface 0 {
            admin-state enable
            ipv4 {
                admin-state enable
                address 10.2.255.5/32 {
                }
            }
            ipv6 {
                admin-state enable
                address 2001:db8:2:ff::5/128 {
                }
            }
        }
    }
    interface mgmt0 {
        admin-state enable
        subinterface 0 {
            admin-state enable
            ipv4 {
                admin-state enable
                dhcp-client {
                }
            }
            ipv6 {
                admin-state enable
                dhcp-client {
                }
            }
        }
    }

# --- network-instance default protocols ospf ---
    instance main {
        admin-state enable
        version ospf-v2
        router-id 10.2.255.5
        area 0.0.0.0 {
            interface ethernet-1/1.0 {
                interface-type point-to-point
                authentication {
                    keychain kc-ospf-r4r5
                }
            }
            interface ethernet-1/2.0 {
                passive true
            }
            interface lo0.0 {
                passive true
            }
        }
    }
    instance v3 {
        admin-state enable
        version ospf-v3
        address-family ipv6-unicast
        router-id 10.2.255.5
        area 0.0.0.0 {
            interface ethernet-1/1.0 {
                interface-type point-to-point
            }
            interface ethernet-1/2.0 {
                passive true
            }
            interface lo0.0 {
                passive true
            }
        }
    }

# --- system authentication ---
    keychain kc-ospf-r4r5 {
        admin-state enable
        type ospf
        key 1 {
            algorithm md5
            authentication-key $aes1$ATI4AKmI25nf/G8=$tAWpbnJF38nTsx8huVlBrw==
        }
    }

# --- system banner ---
    login-banner "Acces reserve - lab de demonstration - toute activite peut etre journalisee"
